fusions.name: Up All at Once
fusions.desc: Takes off in a burst of wings, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Migrant's Quill
fusions.desc: Throws a quill at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the far end of its reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). It holds 4 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Lift and Settle
fusions.desc: Lifts you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, with 10% more dodge chance. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tailwind Habit
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently 10% higher, and you take 15% less wind damage.
